snippet.title: ASTRONEER PS5 Version Coming November 20th!
snippet.description:
Astroneer PS5 Version Coming November 20th!

That's right! The upgrade a lot of you have asked for is coming as a free upgrade (for almost all regions), with: 

- 4K Native Resolution
- 60FPS
- Dualsense Support

PURCHASE HERE: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/234630
